qa_pairs.question: What transmission is shown in the modification information?
Since when has the synchronization been modified?
How many grooves does operating sleeve (1) have?
What is the installation orientation for operating sleeve (3)?
qa_pairs.answer: Operating sleeve (3) with three grooves is installed with shouldered end facing 3rd gear or grooves facing 4th gear.

qa_pairs.question: What is the part number for the 1st/Reverse gear synchromesh ring?
What is the part number for the 2nd to 5th gear synchromesh ring?
What tooth characteristic distinguishes the 1st/Reverse gear synchromesh ring?
What tooth characteristic distinguishes the 2nd to 5th gear synchromesh ring?
Can modified shift parts be installed in all transmission 260/5 units?
qa_pairs.answer: No, modified shift parts can not be installed in transmissions manufactured before 5.85 (hard operation).
